title: cup-product-grid widget params
description: A self-contained 'drag-and-multiply' engine for a graded ring's multiplication table — built for cohomology rings (the cup product). The reader picks a space from a dropdown and clicks a cell of the basis x basis grid; the engine shows the product alpha . beta as an element of the ring, with the degrees ADDING (deg p + deg q = deg p+q), the graded-commutativity sign (-1)^{pq} relating the cell to its transpose, and products that vanish (x^{n+1}=0 past the top dimension, a^2=0 in an exterior algebra) shown as 0. It turns 'cohomology is a ring' from a sentence into a table you can read off. The renderer owns the grid rendering, the ring dropdown, the cell selection + highlight (including the transpose/sign partner), and the readout; the rings (basis + product rule) are author-supplied. The gesture is 'drag-multiply' — multiplying two graded classes and watching degree + sign bookkeeping. Pure DOM/table rendering; jsdom-safe (no getScreenCTM/rAF).

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.

gridId.description: DOM id for the <div> the engine fills with the multiplication <table>.

outputId.description: DOM id for the .readout the engine writes the selected product into.

selectId.description: DOM id for the <select> space/ring picker.

hint.description: Optional hint in .hd > .hint. Should tell the reader to pick a space and click a cell.

cases.description: The rings offered in the dropdown. Each carries a `label` (dropdown text) and optional `ringLabel` (the ring presentation shown in the readout). The basis and product rule for case index ci come from ring(ci) in bodyScript.

ringLabel.description: Optional ring presentation shown in the readout (plain text / simple symbols).

bodyScript.description: Author JS. MUST define `function ring(ci){ return { basis: [{name, deg}, ...], prod: function(i, j){ return {c, k} | null; } }; }` where ci is the selected case index, `basis` lists the ring's additive basis (name string + integer degree), and `prod(i,j)` returns the product of basis[i] and basis[j] as a coefficient `c` times basis element index `k` (or null for 0). Must respect graded-commutativity (prod(i,j) and prod(j,i) differ by (-1)^{deg_i*deg_j}). Evaluated once at render; must not start a timer or touch the DOM.

resetLabel.description: Optional label for a button that clears the selection. Default '↺ Clear'.
